name: python-hamming-distance
title: Hamming Distance
blurb: count differing positions: hamming counts the differing bits between two nonnegative integers, hamming_text counts the differing characters between two equal-length strings, and the audit reports any triple whose expected distance does not match the computed one; out-of-range or malformed inputs are named, never measured.
default_description: A distance walker whose bit count is the population of the xor on every small pair, whose char count is the mismatched positions on every equal-length pair, and whose audit names every triple that fails to match.

verify.name: install
verify.cmd: uv venv --python 3.12 --allow-existing && uv pip install --python .venv/bin/python -e . pytest ruff

detect.contains: hamming counts the bits that disagree
